stem: How did the government respond to the situation shown on this map?

options.label: A
options.text: By eliminating federal farm subsidies to reduce the market prices of crops

options.label: B
options.text: By providing federal tax incentives to replace trees with wheat crops

options.label: C
options.text: By removing federal land restrictions to expand land available for cattle grazing

options.label: D
options.text: By directing federal agencies to create programs to promote soil conservation
